summary: Friedberg declines to take a firm valuation stance on Palantir, noting the market is trying to price future earnings potential where opinions differ widely, and he has not studied the business sufficiently to have a strong view.
quote: I've not studied the business well. I don't have a strong point of view or opinion on the value of the business. Relative to its future earnings potential. That's how I would look at it.
